The '''folded ear boosqueak''' was a rare, arboreal [[Species/Legends|species]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fedje]], located within the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Fedje was noted for its exotic lifeforms, as exemplified by the creature.<ref name="Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The folded ear boosqueak was created for the [[Star Wars video games|strategy game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], produced by [[LucasArts]] in [[1998]]. It was mentioned in the in-game encyclopedia entry for the planet Fedje, as an example of one of the "many forms of exotic arboreal lifeforms" native to the planet.<ref name="Rebellion" />
